internal.title: Incident Resolved: Checkout Service Error Rate Spike Due to Payment Service Flag
internal.body: At 10:09 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the checkout service. Diagnosis identified the root cause as an error injection in the payment service caused by the 'paymentFailure' flag being enabled at 100%. This flag caused checkout to fail charging cards with 'Invalid token' errors, resulting in a 95% error rate. The flag was disabled at 10:29 UTC after approval, leading to immediate recovery and normalization of error rates. No other services were significantly impacted. The incident is now resolved.

external.title: Some checkouts failed due to payment processing issues
external.body: Between 10:09 and 10:29 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced issues completing checkout due to payment processing errors. The issue was identified and resolved promptly, and normal service has been restored. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
